notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
